shortDescription: Libya's National Oil Corporation said the forced closure of a valve on the Sharara-Zawiya crude pipeline by an armed group had caused the loss of more than 720,000 barrels of production and over $75 million in direct losses as of September 24.

children: Libya's National Oil Corporation said the forced closure of a valve on the Sharara-Zawiya crude pipeline by an armed group had caused the loss of more than 720,000 barrels of production and over $75 million in direct losses as of September 24.
An armed group closed valve 7 on the ​Sharara ​crude pipeline ‌to ⁠Zawiya port on September 21.
NOC warned that the Zawiya refinery could begin halting units as its crude reserves run low.
